summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  ### What's actually happening (root cause identified via read-only investigation) The backend is correct: `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` enforces session auth on every route, resolves `X-User-Id` from the verified session cookie, and all reads/writes are properly scoped by `user_id` in the DB (`modules/watchlist/schema.ts`). This is not a missing-feature or backend-scoping bug.  The bug is on the client: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` fetches the watchlist once in a `useEffect` keyed only on `[toast]` — it never depends on
